record.category: DDL release index (defunct; domain now a parking router)

free_tier.stated: none: the domain no longer serves an index. The root returned 5,591 bytes titled 'Redirecting...' whose script posts browser fingerprints to https://router.parklogic.com/

egress.terms: none: there is no content to serve

record.interface_detail: The only interface is a JavaScript interstitial that either replaces the document with a parklogic routing answer or runs an ad-blocking and webdriver check first.
record.tooling: A browser gets redirected; there is no feed, no API and no host link. A command-line client receives the same 5,591-byte interstitial.
record.chaining: None. ReleaseBB cannot sit in the stack. The live DDL feeds measured among debrid providers are scnlog.me, ddlbase.com and rlsbb.cc.

limits.value: the interstitial gates on ad-blocking detection, iframe and webdriver flags, GPU vendor and timezone before answering

record.binding_note: There is nothing to meter and no rate to observe; the domain serves a parking page rather than an index.

identity_cost.detail: No signup path exists on the served page.

record.reliability_note: Parked domain: the served page carries no release data, so a client pointed at it receives an ad or a redirect rather than a post.
record.confidence_note: The root was fetched raw on 2026-10-23 and the interstitial's own base64 parameters were decoded: they name domainApex 'releasebb.net' and tenant 'seth3'. A second capture on another day would show whether the parking is permanent.

evidence.proved: raw root is 5,591 bytes titled 'Redirecting...' and POSTs fingerprints to https://router.parklogic.com/ with domainApex 'releasebb.net'
the reader's extractor found 1 word in the page and refused it as 'no content', consistent with an interstitial rather than an index

record.notes: Distinct from rlsbb.cc, which is still alive and whose feed channel is also titled 'ReleaseBB'. The two names are the same brand on different domains; only rlsbb.cc serves posts today. Not deleted, because a name this common will be searched again.
